title: A handoff or report that cites a page item number also gives its short name
why: A repo's triage handoff named items 46 and 47 by number only, so the next session could not tell which was the search pill clear button and which the stale head-vocabulary record (owner's ask ask-mw79tmz6x2, 21:26 CST Nov 7). Rule speak-cite-id-plus-gloss covers it, but no check holds it for item numbers.
note: Check for the handoff writer and the report guard: an `item <n>` cite carries the item's short name or slug. Related: page-item-id-check. Filed 21:30 CST Nov 7. Lane session_013NEJKzKA8bkAW7ossmC85D started (coordinator, received 21:39 CST Nov 7).
